arenas.montanhas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production landscape background for a 2D Dragon Ball browser battle arena. Art direction: beautiful Dragon Ball Attack of the Saiyans / Nintendo DS era turn-based JRPG battlefield, richly painted cel-shaded anime scenery with crisp deliberate outlines and subtle retro pixel texture, vivid color and layered atmospheric depth, polished modern resolution. Wide 16:9 composition. Camera fixed at side-view fighter height, mild perspective, NOT top-down. Empty battlefield: the left and right foreground must offer broad unobstructed level ground where separate character sprites will stand, feet baseline around 82 percent image height. Foreground ground occupies lower 32 percent, environment occupies upper 68 percent. A clear central battle lane, distant scenic details, exciting cinematic natural lighting. Background ONLY: absolutely NO characters, enemies, people, creatures, energy attacks, text, lettering, borders, HUD, interface, logos or watermark. Fully opaque image. Scene: iconic Dragon Ball rocky mountain canyon, rounded ochre sandstone pillars of varying heights framing the distant valley, brilliant blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, distant indigo mountains. Broad flat orange rock plateau in the foreground for two opposing fighters, cracks and a few small stones along bottom edge, no rocks obstruct fighter positions. Warm sunlight, clean dramatic depth.

fighters.saiyajin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D game SPRITE SHEET, NOT an illustration portrait, for a Dragon Ball browser RPG inspired by Nintendo DS Dragon Ball Attack of the Saiyans. TRUE low-resolution pixel sprite style: strongly deliberate visible square pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, limited cel-shaded palette, dark one-pixel outlines, charming slightly compact proportions, detailed expressive readable face. Render three DIFFERENT full-body frames of the SAME character in exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS in ONE ROW, each independent with wide transparent margin. Wide landscape canvas. Each character has the same apparent scale and the feet share the same baseline at 88 percent height within its cell. Three-quarter SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in every frame. Frame 1: idle martial arts guard, knees slightly bent, two fists poised. Frame 2: dynamic physical ATTACK pose with a forward punch / strike, the forward hand extends to the RIGHT. Frame 3: KI ATTACK pose, both hands / palms projecting energy to the RIGHT but do NOT draw the energy projectile. Normal accurate anatomy and feet, no backwards feet. Full heads, hair, hands, ears, capes and tails inside OWN cell. No figure crosses a cell boundary. Preserve character's recognizable identity and outfit, avoid text/kanji on clothes. Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no background, no checkerboard, no ground, no floor shadow, no glow, no labels, no writing, no frame borders, no watermark. Characters ONLY, sprite pixels rather than realistic anatomy or painted poster art. Character: canonical normal base-form Son Goku, black spiky hair, orange gi over blue undershirt, blue wristbands, blue belt, blue boots with subtle red trim. Heroic determined expression.

kicks.saiyajin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art fighting game sprite. Input image is a style and character reference sheet ONLY: match the exact fighter, colors, clothing, proportions, pixel clusters and dark pixel outline of the LEFTMOST idle pose. Create ONE single full-body sprite of this same fighter performing a powerful side kick to the RIGHT, seen from a three-quarter side view, one leg extended horizontally to the right with a correctly oriented foot, the other leg planted, arms guarding his chest. Dragon Ball Nintendo DS / 16-bit JRPG battle sprite, compact hand-drawn pixel clusters, not smooth vector, not realistic illustration. Match the body/head scale of the reference. True transparent background. Generous transparent margin around ALL sides; the entire head, hands, kick foot, tail if present, and planted boot must be completely visible without touching any edge. One fighter and one pose ONLY, no other poses, no writing, no ground, no shadows, no auras or projectiles. Anatomy: two arms and two legs only; kicking foot must point right with natural ankle; no backward foot.
